score:f9.notes: All four required files are present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), plus the session's scripts and outputs; checks/ was read only for o2p_flags.txt and match_check.txt and was not credited to the session. The session did open vector artifacts (vectors.py/vec2.py over semantic-vectors-index.json, the binary, the map and Tier-2 shards), so V1–V6 and V8 are scored. Verifications I ran on the read-only copy and bundle: the coverage query reproduces 553|321749|1103|8481; the family counts (\"soft power\" 0, `soft` 349/76, union family 2,009, Fulbright 381/59, Pacific islands 6/5, polls+USIA 157/36, Oriental-mind 30/22, \"public diplomacy\" R 2 / I 78), the ranked COUNT 1,284, the header sets 42 and 99, the R/I denominators 37,199/1,816 and the 141's came-from grouping 66 RG 59 / 40 RG 306 all reproduce; Q7, Q11, Q12 and Q34 are exact substrings of body_text on non-apparatus rows; frus1952-54v13p1/d116 is absent from candidate_set.txt and returns 0 on the ranked predicate, so the \"reached only by vectors\" claim holds; the lot→NAID resolutions match central-files-index.json; the index digest equals semantic-shards-manifest.json's and SemanticVectors/.generation's. Judgement calls: I2 treats `d.rowid=f.rowid` as the FTS5 content join, not an identifier; V1 is obeyed on the code's asserts although the shards manifest was never consulted and the .generation read is a memo claim not in the log; V2 is violated because the only identity check is a per-volume count round-trip, with no spot check of a known pair; V6 is violated on [M22]'s six unlabelled centroid cosines alone; V8 is obeyed because the banned list names \"neighbour at N\", and the overview and one collection note use \"semantic neighbours\" with no distance or rank; O2' includes the four Read-next list enumerators among the UNTRACED by the rubric's letter, but 24 substantive numbers (two volume-set sizes, the Fulbright count, lots 66 D 95 and 65 D 101, the three unplaced lots, \"Twenty years later\", structural counts) are untraced regardless. The memo also has a trace row for a decade-rate claim (\"rate rises from about 18 per 1,000...\") that the overview text does not contain.
